verdict.rationale: Alloy's own marketing claims KYB and AML checks, which is a glancing first-party mention of screening business entities. Nothing in the pack documents inspecting linked ownership, beneficial owners or association risk context; entity merging and external entity IDs are record management, not ownership-risk inspection. Missing for 10: documented KYB business-entity screening workflow, beneficial-ownership/UBO linkage, association/network risk views for analysts, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a risk-analyst, I can screen business entities and inspect their linked ownership or association risk context

citations.quote: Streamline perpetual KYC/KYB, AML, and fraud checks with fully auditable agentic automation
